title: Graceful Isolation Lattice and SLO Escort Hotfix
author: Priya Anand
release_notes: Hotfix: introduce lattice-based tenant isolation to enable staged soft-shedding and SLO Escort to preserve priority during regional failovers. Backwards compatible; feature gated. Includes telemetry tags and fast rollback path.
description: Motivation: an incident (SUP-7890) revealed oscillation when tenants were abruptly evicted during partial regional egress congestion. This PR introduces a lattice-based isolation model and an SLO Escort component to make evictions progressive, observable, and reversible without violating high-tier SLOs. Summary of changes: 1) isolation/lattice_manager: new lattice state machine that tracks tenant posture across soft, probationary, and hardened eviction levels; transitions are timeboxed and instrumented with causality IDs; 2) isolation/policy_evaluator: new scoring hook that computes a degradability score combining token-rate, latency quantiles, and recent KV pressure; 3) sleight-of-hand SLO Escort: a lightweight orchestrator that carries SLO priority markers across routing/region-fallback decisions so we avoid demoting high-priority tenants during transient egress spikes; 4) telemetry: add slo_escort_{decision,reason} metrics and a traceability tag for tenant lattice transitions; 5) tests and a fast rollback feature flag (FF_ISOLATION_LATTICE) to revert to previous behavior if needed. Checklist: [x] unit tests for lattice transitions, [x] integration test for region failover path, [x] CI smoke validated, [x] telemetry dashboards added, [x] feature-flag gating and documented rollback steps, [ ] docs: expanded operational runbook (follow-up small PR). Risk/rollout: gated behind FF_ISOLATION_LATTICE and staged rollout to a single region for 24h canary. Related: ENG-2345 for long-term scheduler work and PM-412 for customer impact tracking. Links: incident SUP-7890, runbook: internal/runbooks/soft-degrade.md. Why unique: lattice model decouples tenant health from immediate eviction decisions and the Escort ensures SLO priorities persist across routing fallback so a regional failover does not cascade demotions.
